pins.title: Gifts for hikers they will actually use
pins.pinTitle: Gifts for hikers: practical ideas they will actually use on the trail
pins.description: Stuck on what to give the hiker in your life? Our gift guide lists practical hiking gifts from free printables to small winter gear, with what each one is good for.

pins.title: A gift for a hiker with big 2027 goals
pins.sub: Year planner, peak log and parks tracker.
pins.pinTitle: Hiking gift for 2027: printable hike planner, peak bagger's logbook and parks tracker
pins.description: A printable gift set for a hiker who sets goals for the new year: the 2027 Hiking Year Planner, a Peak Bagger's Logbook and the US National Parks Hiking Tracker. Instant download, print at home.

pins.title: A tiny trail journal for their stocking
pins.sub: Print it, fold it, give it.
pins.pinTitle: Hiking stocking stuffer: a printable pocket trail journal you fold from one sheet
pins.description: The Pocket Trail Log is a printable mini hiking journal you fold from one sheet of paper, with writing prompts, a summit log and gift tags. A small stocking stuffer for hikers, ready the same day.

pins.title: Know someone who just started hiking?
pins.pinTitle: Gift for a new hiker: beginner hiking guide, packing checklist and trip planner
pins.description: A practical gift for someone new to hiking: our Beginner Hiker Bundle has the Beginner's Hiking Guide, a packing checklist and a trip planner. Printable, instant download.

pins.title: A gift for their next national park trip
pins.pinTitle: National park trip gift: printable planners for the Smokies, Utah's Mighty 5 and Yellowstone
pins.description: For the road-tripper who wants to see more parks: our three printable trip planning guides for the Great Smoky Mountains, Utah's Mighty 5 and Yellowstone with Grand Teton. Check nps.gov for current conditions before any trip.

pins.title: Not sure what to wear on a winter hike?
pins.sub: See the guide: what to wear by temperature.
pins.pinTitle: What to wear winter hiking: layers by temperature, plus a cold-weather checklist
pins.description: Winter hiking clothes are about layers you can add and remove: a base layer that wicks sweat, an insulating layer and a wind and water shell. Our Winter Hiking Guide shows what to wear at each temperature and has a cold-weather day-hike checklist.

pins.title: Cold floors all winter?
pins.sub: Merino socks, at home and out the door.
pins.pinTitle: Merino wool socks for cold floors at home, the office and winter walks
pins.description: Cold tile and wood floors make for cold feet all winter. Our cushioned crew socks are 80% merino as labelled, warm indoors and out: at home, at work, on dog walks and on the trail. Sold as one pair, in four colours.

pins.title: A gift they will wear all winter
pins.pinTitle: Merino wool socks gift: warm cushioned crew socks for cold days
pins.description: Warm socks are a gift that gets used every cold day: at home, on the commute, on ski trips and on the trail. Ours are 80% merino as labelled, cushioned, crew height, in four colours. Sold as one pair.

pins.title: For the hiker who remembers every trail
pins.sub: Journal, parks tracker and trip planner.
pins.pinTitle: Hiking gift set printable: hiking journal, national parks tracker and trip planner
pins.description: A printable gift set for a hiker who likes to plan trips and remember them: a hiking journal and trail log, a US national parks hiking tracker and a trip planner. Instant download in US Letter, A4 and a mobile edition.

pins.title: Your state parks deserve a passport too
pins.pinTitle: State parks passport printable: track every state and provincial park you visit
pins.description: A printable state parks passport for the US and Canada: a checklist of all 50 states and 13 provinces and territories with each parks agency, visit logs with stamp boxes and maps to color in. A small gift for park lovers.
